metadata.evaluation_name: Scoring Adaptive Cache Admission vs Tuned Baseline
metadata.description: Self-contained shadow-queue simulation and evaluation: per-key-decay admission variant vs best-tuned W-TinyLFU global-reset baseline. No upstream experiment/dataset artifacts were available (empty gen_art_experiment_1 and gen_art_dataset_1 directories), so the simulator, synthetic traces, and evaluation were all generated here.
